description: Synthetic Project Orion passages for a keyless lexical retrieval baseline. These are evaluation data, not claims about Document Intelligence or a real organization.

passages.text: Project Orion stores metadata in PostgreSQL. Original documents are stored separately in object storage.
Each visitor receives a temporary workspace token that scopes access to their own documents.
Workspace access expires 24 hours after a successful upload or a saved question. Reading a file does not renew access.
A visitor can manually delete the temporary workspace and its files at any time.
Citation identifiers are checked against retrieved passages. Human review checks whether each passage actually supports its claim.
La inspección semanal revisa los sensores y registra cualquier fallo en el cuaderno de mantenimiento.
